CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION hr_public.cancel_batch(p_batch_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    UPDATE hr_public.bulk_rollback_batches
    SET
        status = 'failed',
        completed_at = now(),
        failure_details = jsonb_build_object(
            'cancelled', true,
            'message', 'Batch cancelled by user',
            'cancelled_at', now()
        )
    WHERE id = p_batch_id
    AND status IN ('queued', 'in_progress');

    RETURN FOUND;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION hr_public.create_document_version()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Only create version if file content changed (storage_path changed)
    IF OLD.storage_path IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.storage_path THEN
        INSERT INTO hr_public.document_versions (
            document_id,
            version_number,
            storage_path,
            encryption_key_id,
            version_created_by,
            change_description,
            file_size_bytes
        ) VALUES (
            OLD.id,
            OLD.version_number,
            OLD.storage_path,
            OLD.encryption_key_id,
            current_setting('jwt.claims.user_id', true)::uuid,
            'Document updated',
            OLD.file_size_bytes
        );

        -- Increment version number in documents table
        NEW.version_number := OLD.version_number + 1;
    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION hr_public."current_user"()
 RETURNS hr_public.users
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT *
  FROM hr_public.users
  WHERE id = current_setting('jwt.claims.user_id', true)::uuid;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION hr_public.encrypt_key_data(p_key_data bytea, p_key_identifier character varying)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
    encryption_password TEXT;
BEGIN
    -- Use key_identifier + server secret as encryption password
    -- In production, use environment variable for server secret
    encryption_password := p_key_identifier || '_SERVER_SECRET_KEY_PLACEHOLDER';

    -- Encrypt using pgcrypto's symmetric encryption (AES-256)
    RETURN pgp_sym_encrypt_bytea(p_key_data, encryption_password);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION hr_public.get_current_compensation(emp_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(salary_amount numeric, salary_currency character varying, pay_frequency character varying, pay_type character varying, effective_date date)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Only HR managers and admins can access compensation data
    IF NOT (
        current_setting('jwt.claims.role', true) IN ('super_admin', 'admin', 'hr_manager')
        OR current_setting('jwt.claims.user_id', true)::uuid = emp_id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Insufficient permissions to view compensation data';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        cr.salary_amount,
        cr.salary_currency,
        cr.pay_frequency,
        cr.pay_type,
        cr.effective_date
    FROM hr_private.compensation_records cr
    WHERE cr.employee_id = emp_id
        AND (cr.end_date IS NULL OR cr.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE)
    ORDER BY cr.effective_date DESC
    LIMIT 1;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION hr_public.get_direct_reports(p_manager_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(employee_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH RECURSIVE direct_reports AS (
        SELECT id FROM hr_public.users WHERE id = p_manager_id
        UNION
        SELECT u.id FROM hr_public.users u
        JOIN direct_reports dr ON u.manager_id = dr.id
    )
    SELECT id FROM direct_reports WHERE id != p_manager_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION hr_public.update_batch_progress(p_batch_id uuid, p_processed_count integer, p_successful_count integer, p_failed_count integer, p_failure_details jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
    batch_total INTEGER;
    new_status TEXT;
BEGIN
    -- Get total count
    SELECT total_count INTO batch_total
    FROM hr_public.bulk_rollback_batches
    WHERE id = p_batch_id;

    -- Determine new status
    IF p_processed_count >= batch_total THEN
        IF p_failed_count > 0 THEN
            new_status := 'failed';
        ELSE
            new_status := 'completed';
        END IF;
    ELSE
        new_status := 'in_progress';
    END IF;

    -- Update batch
    UPDATE hr_public.bulk_rollback_batches
    SET
        processed_count = p_processed_count,
        successful_count = p_successful_count,
        failed_count = p_failed_count,
        failure_details = COALESCE(p_failure_details, failure_details),
        status = new_status,
        completed_at = CASE
            WHEN new_status IN ('completed', 'failed') THEN now()
            ELSE completed_at
        END
    WHERE id = p_batch_id;

    RETURN FOUND;
END;
$function$
